sleep 75; curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs -o /tmp/r2.json; python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/r2.json'))
c=d['accounts'].get('cand')
print('cand' , bool(c))
if c:
    print(json.dumps(c['filter']))
    a=c['account']; print('equity',a['equity'],'taken',a['taken'],'closed',a['closed'],'wins',a['wins'],'open pos',len(a['positions']))
    print('signals',json.dumps({k:c['signals'][k] for k in ('n','wins','win_pct','open','total')}))
print('all signals',d['accounts']['both']['signals']['n'])
for p in d['proposals']['pending'][:6]:
    print(p['sym'],p['tf'],p['side'],p.get('sig'),'stop%',p.get('stop_pct'),'stopATR',p.get('stop_atr'),'tp%',p.get('tp_pct'),'tpATR',p.get('tp_atr'),'atr%',p.get('atr'),'cand',p.get('cand_ok'),p.get('cand_why'))
rows=d['proposals']['rows']; print('rows with atr',sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('atr')),'of',len(rows),'cand_ok',sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('cand_ok')))
"
